[1] 《The Last First: Winter K2》promises "an unflinching look at the extreme mountaineering industry and its evolving culture." Watch the trailer below.

[1] 《The Last First: Winter K2》will premiere on October 2.

[2] Apple TV will premiere 《The Last First: Winter K2》 on October 2, a documentary that "tells a complex, gripping and moving story" exposing the face of extreme mountaineering, and is currently holding a rare 100% fresh rating on Rotten Tomatoes.

[3] Apple TV previously announced it had acquired the global broadcast rights to 《The Last First: Winter K2》, and noted the documentary was selected for the Sundance Film Festival.

[4] A few weeks ago, the platform set the premiere date for October 2, and today released the documentary's trailer, which can be seen below.
